summary: VV's specification and margin-notes system matches TV as of roughly 17-20 Sep (TV v2.63-v2.70). Everything TV added from v2.91 on is missing in VV: the specification lockstep with its local file (v2.163), WriteLocalCopy and the single write queue (v2.144), the bubble note resolver and Locate (v2.144), Overspill Note Regions (v2.143), Leaderless Notes (v2.147), Floor Areas (v2.104/v2.125/v2.148), the Colour Palette (v2.126/v2.133), and Spell Check with the user dictionary (v2.144). Two gaps are live data-safety faults in VV today. (1) Sync writes ValeVision__DrawingNotes__.json through the two-phase Na__R2Notes__Write without looking at the file, and a browser draft is put back unasked over a newer file. (2) Reload Local treats the file as the cloud copy, so an agent's edit loaded that way never reaches R2. TV fixed exactly this in Transport 1.3.0. No renames are needed. Every shared spec file already sits at the same path in both apps. Every TV-only folder number this slice needs is free in VV: top-level 54 and 55, LE/59 and LE/52/01__Core__Data. App-identity tokens are the only naming seams. Hard ordering point: VV SheetRecords NormaliseMarginNotes rebuilds the record and would silently drop the RegionsOn, Regions, LeaderlessOn and LeaderlessGroups keys, so the records work must land first. VV History also still lacks the 'margin' and 'areas' undo reasons; the ledger has had 'margin' open since 20-Sep. No Cloudflare worker change or deploy is needed. VV needs Flask work: a user-config blueprint for the spelling dictionary, plus Last-Modified and an atomic write on the drawing-notes route. Floor Areas is the largest package (about 25 shared hot files) and depends on several other slices: PaintOrder, ViewportRotation, OrthoMode, Grips, SheetTools, DrawingTools. The overspill-region grips depend on the ObjectSnap, DrawingGrid and OrthoMode ports. The drift table wrongly marks SpecData Editing and Draft as header-only; both carry required code changes.

findings.title: VV spec Sync overwrites on-disk edits; drafts restored unasked
findings.detail: VV Transport 1.1.0 has no lockstep. Sync calls Na__R2Notes__Write (worker POST then Flask POST of the same document) without looking at ValeVision__DrawingNotes__.json, so an agent's or hand edit made since load is overwritten. EnsureLoaded calls RestoreDraft() unconditionally, putting a browser draft back over a newer file with only a toast. TV v2.163 (Transport 1.3.0 + Lockstep 1.0.0) looks before every write, watches the file, autosaves to it and asks when the two disagree.
findings.recommendation: Port TV Transport 1.3.0 whole with VV seams plus the adapted Lockstep unit (WP-S06b-01). Sync must write R2 through a cloud-only call and leave the local write to the lockstep's MirrorLocal(out,{look:true}).

findings.vv_adaptation: Keep the R2Notes read path (worker-or-CDN), CanReloadCloud = project code in the URL, the project-code Sync gate and the 'Worker config unavailable' toast; no UsesWorker/FetchJson/legacy file name; 42__ drawing-core path.

findings.title: VV Reload Local marks the file as the cloud copy (unsynced edit lost)
findings.detail: VV ReloadFromLocal calls Adopt({status:READY,data:local,source:'repository'}), which sets BaseStamp and SyncedJson from the file. IsDirty() is then false and Sync/Save Sheets stay off, so an agent's edit loaded with Reload Local never reaches R2 unless something else changes. TV Transport 1.3.0 uses AdoptFile (cloud bookkeeping kept, so it reads unsynced), asks only when the app holds something the file lacks, and keeps what it replaces.
findings.recommendation: Take TV's ReloadFromLocal (FileKey/LockJson comparison, KeepDiscarded, AdoptFile) inside WP-S06b-01. If WP-01 is delayed, hot-fix by keeping the cloud BaseStamp/SyncedJson when reloading the local file.

The header NAMESPACE says Na__AppUtils, but the functions are Na__R2Notes__*.

findings.title: Flask drawing-notes route: no Last-Modified, in-place write, no backup
findings.detail: WCP/server.py drawing_notes GET returns jsonify(json.load(f)) with no Last-Modified, and POST truncates and writes in place. TV serves the local file statically (with Last-Modified), writes every JSON atomically (write_text_atomic, v2.144) and backs the notes up before each overwrite (v2.146). The lockstep still works without Last-Modified (it falls back to UpdatedIso), but the Newer badge and the 'when' text get coarser, and a crash mid-write can truncate the notes.
findings.recommendation: GET: set Last-Modified from os.path.getmtime and Cache-Control: no-store. POST: write via write_text_atomic, imported from the new user-config blueprint as TV's main server does. Do backup-before-overwrite with the persistence slice (D-S06b-06).
